notes.title: 🚨 IT’S OUT!! THE DEMO IS HERE!!!🚨
notes.content:
Speedrunners, it's time to test your skills! The demo for Tails Noir: Rebel Rush is live! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33103339/a8e867f6fa9fb525b882fa05fa6dd89971657637.gif[/img]

- Be the best, the fastest, the most DARING driver the world has ever known (and prove it by putting your name as high as possible on the leaderboard)
- Play smart. Also hard. Invent the shortcuts, ride the buildings, do whatever the hell you want! The whole map is your playground and it’s up to you what to do with this information
- Send the police flying, break through the obstacles, smash the chandelier: who’s gonna stop you anyway?
- Collect the hearts scattered across the levels and you’ll be in for a treat
- Pray

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33103339/fc7d2a45d2afa1db5c86d6352e3cfd8f052b3215.png[/img]

Think you’ve got what it takes? 🦊💥
